summary: Master select-all checkbox (input.vol-head-check) correctly stages candidate prompts into volumesState.selectedPromptIds, slides the sticky bulk action toolbar (.vol-bulk-toolbar) into view with dynamic count badge ('13 prompt seçildi'), launches the Bulk Save modal (.vol-md-modal) with tag preview chips for selected terms, and successfully creates custom watchlist ('Q4 High Intent Focus') while resetting staged selection state and dismissing the toolbar.
